device_name: Pipeline Flex Embolization Device with Shield Technology
device_name_fda: Pipeline Flex Embolization Device with Shield Technology
what_it_is: Third-generation flow diverter embolization device for placement in parent vessel across the neck of intracranial aneurysms. Diverts flow away from aneurysm neck and reconstructs parent artery. Shield Technology is a surface modification using phosphorylcholine to reduce thrombogenicity. Reference device in flow diversion with 10 years of experience and highest number of clinical studies.
indications: Treatment of intracranial aneurysms (IA) by endovascular placement across the aneurysm neck in the parent vessel.
use_notes: Shield Technology (phosphorylcholine surface modification) shown to reduce thrombogenicity in vitro. Pipeline embolization devices are the reference in flow diversion. 1-year follow-up data available from PFLEX study.
